item.title: Raiders trading Maxx Crosby to Ravens in blockbuster deal
item.description: Crosby, the Raiders’ locker room leader and a five-time Pro Bowl player, goes to the Ravens in exchange for two first-round draft picks as Las Vegas looks to rebuild.

item.title: Grading the trade: How did the Raiders fare in Maxx Crosby deal?
item.description: The Raiders were able to land a pair of premium draft picks in exchange for disgruntled defensive star Maxx Crosby.

item.title: Two pedestrians on Strip struck by vehicle, hospitalized, police say
item.description: The vehicle hit the pair Friday night in the 3600 block of Las Vegas Boulevard, near Las Vegas Boulevard and Flamingo Road.

item.title: Golden Knights captain’s injury not deemed serious, GM says
item.description: Golden Knights general manager Kelly McCrimmon said captain Mark Stone’s injury is “manageable” and isn’t expected to miss extended time.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Burned by bureaucracy
item.description: There’s a major difference between big government and competent government.

item.title: LETTER: The troubling history of Glen Canyon Dam
item.description: Is it time to remove it?

item.title: LETTER: AI an opportunity, not a threat
item.description: Don’t fear it, prepare for it.

item.title: Dra Gibbs-Lawhorn’s 32 points not enough in Rebels’ loss at San Diego State
item.description: The UNLV men’s basketball team ended the regular season with an 89-86 loss to one of the top teams in the Mountain West.

item.title: Friday’s high school scores, top performances
item.description: Check out the scores and top performances from Frday’s high school baseball, softball and boys volleyball action.

item.title: Golden Knights fall out of first in the division, lose 4-2 to Wild
item.description: The Golden Knights fell behind as the Wild scored three goals in three minutes in the second period to send Vegas to its fourth loss in five games.
